question: What is the dumbest reason you have ever been banned from somewhere?
story: I am banned for life from a buffet, and it has nothing to do with how much I ate. It is because of a fish. I was nineteen, working a summer job, and my coworkers and I went every Friday. There was a koi pond in the lobby with a sign that said please do not feed the fish. One night a friend bet me twenty dollars I would not name the biggest one. So I did. I called him Gerald. I said hello to Gerald every week, out loud, by name, until other customers started doing it too. Within a month people were asking the hostess how Gerald was doing. Someone made a sign. Here is what ended it. Management put up a laminated notice saying the fish had no name, and I laughed until I had to leave. The next Friday my photo was taped by the door. Not for stealing. For, and I quote, disrupting the pond.
